headline: OpenAI introduces LifeVal, an evaluation of AI agents on everyday-life tasks
summary: OpenAI introduced LifeVal, an evaluation of AI performance on everyday-life tasks selected using American and multinational time-use datasets and supplemented by a demographically representative survey of 3,995 respondents. Its public page reports selected GPT-6 Astra scores of 90.4%–100% on illustrated workflows, but does not give an overall aggregate result or a detailed open protocol. The design and scores are first-party; independent replication and real-world user outcomes are not established.
